# Zahid Rasheed

> Head of AI @ Aeven | AVP | Sovereign AI, AI strategy to business outcomes | Ex-Head of Development, TDC Brands | Berlingske Talent 100

## Summary

Zahid Rasheed spearheads the AI transformation at Aeven, bridging executive strategy with hands-on technical execution — operationalizing AI with compliance, governance, and European sovereign infrastructure standards. Previously Head of Development at TDC Brands, leading a ~70-person Development cluster (~62 M DKK annual budget). Berlingske Talent 100 (2024). Originally from Pakistan, he lives in Denmark.

## Current role

- **Title:** Head of AI / Associate Vice President
- **Company:** Aeven A/S
- **Location:** Copenhagen, Denmark
- **Focus:** Sovereign AI, AI strategy, business outcomes, EU AI Act compliance, governed LLM use

## Background

- Senior Software Engineer → Head of Development at TDC Brands (YouSee/Nuuday)
- Senior Software Engineer at Kayak (Booking Holdings)
- Software engineering roles at Unwire and FlickerLab ApS
- M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence, University of Leeds (2010–2012)
- BSc Computer Science, CIIT Islamabad (2006–2010)
- Berlingske Talent 100, 2024
- Originally from Pakistan; based in Denmark
- Interests: photography, travel, continuous personal growth
